title: Octatrace bounded field handshake profile v2

cose_key.point: uncompressed SEC1 P-256, 65 bytes; both coordinates in CCS

credentials.kid: first 8 bytes of SHA256(exact CCS bytes); not a trust anchor
credentials.id_cred: COSE kid label 4; no credential by value
credentials.resolution: exact independently expected peer/role/key/current installed authority; reject unknown or ambiguous references

prelude.trust: untrusted until real EDHOC and protected context confirmation

binding.transcript: authenticated EDHOC TH_4, 32 bytes; never transport-header or caller-success flag
binding.profile_hash: SHA256 of exact profile.json file bytes
binding.export_context: SHA256(ASCII OCTATRACE-FIELD-EXPORT-1 || exact b3 field record)
binding.confirmation_nonce: 13 zero bytes; separate per-direction/per-attempt exporter key; encrypt once and replay cached ciphertext only
binding.application_aead: AES-128-CCM, 16-byte tag, 13-byte nonce; separate from EDHOC suite-2 internal 8-byte tag; no OSCORE adoption

radio.frame_encoding: fixed 74 bytes; zero-pad final payload; reject nonzero padding; total length excludes padding
radio.airtime: existing shared radio::Airtime, including boot and uncertain TX; no reset
radio.receiver_selector: first 8 bytes of SHA256(ASCII OCTATRACE-FIELD-RECEIVER-1 || kind1 || attempt_uuid16 || intended_receiver_public_key_sha25632); public routing only, never authority; recompute per attempt and direction

bluetooth.frame_encoding: fixed 20 bytes; zero-pad final payload; reject nonzero padding; total length excludes padding
bluetooth.correlation: current verified intended LINK connection generation plus complete prelude attempt UUID; disconnect clears temporary attempt
bluetooth.mtu: fixed baseline 20-byte attribute value; no larger-MTU requirement

lifecycle.deadline: monotonic absolute attempt deadline; includes fragments, retries, waits and processing; no renewal on duplicate/sleep/reconnect
lifecycle.retry: exact cached flight bytes; no new nonce, ephemeral key, protocol advance or budget on duplicate
lifecycle.completion: Initiator requires responder context confirmation; Responder requires initiator confirmation and retains exact response until original deadline; never infer remote delivery
lifecycle.cancel: clear temporary material/partial frames; preserve installed authority, command budgets and retained data
lifecycle.reboot: discard ephemeral readiness; load verified installed identity/authority; no implicit Start
lifecycle.offline: no wall-clock expiry or online renewal of installed owner permission
lifecycle.implementation: C4.4.2 authenticated binding/provider qualified in isolation; C4.4.3 transport and C4.4.4 bounded resources are separate foundations; live C8 and physical C9
